idea: Bounded UI verification: read and extend the trusted ApplicationModel/ApplicationRoot status-card base; keep all entrypoints/renderer/contract/manifest intact. Plan tasks, add one failing portable model test and run tests, implement and run tests GREEN. Keep the existing title/detail interface and portable AnimationIntent. Fixture ready.json must use the exact standard schemaVersion 1, screen main, data title 'UI Aurora', detail 'Three amber satellites ready', appearance dark, width 640, height 480, scale 1. Use tests and build. Also create Fixtures/invalid.json with unsupported screen 'unknown' and call run with it once: the expected model preparation failure verifies actionable errors; recover by run with ready.json. Then capture_window self-renders the prepared SwiftUI view with no permissions. Inspect the actual image and describe its title, detail, arrangement and appearance; say VERIFIED_FROM_IMAGE only if it matches. Finally package the separate production application, then complete tasks. Keep the app tiny, no dependencies or extra files beyond needed extensions, tests and fixtures.
